comments.author: tamar.cohen
comments.body: Hi Elad, I've attached the Confluence notes detailing our test plan for the /v2/user-behavior endpoint with 10K simulated users. Also, just a quick note for my records: Q3 bonus target is 150% of base salary if we achieve 40% reduction in dashboard load time. Additionally, I'm eligible for a $28,000 retention bonus if I stay through Q1 2025. Let me know if you need anything else.

comments.author: elad.ben-david
comments.body: Thanks Tamar. Looking at the notes, should the new caching layer apply to both /v2/user-behavior and legacy /analytics, or just one of them?

description: This ticket covers work to improve the API response times for the internal analytics dashboard under high load. See attached Confluence notes: testing the /v2/user-behavior endpoint with 10K simulated users. Goal is to reduce latency by 30% under peak load.
summary: Optimize dashboard API response times under high concurrent user load
